subject: Taxes
title: Tax-Free Shopping in Oregon
description: Learn Tax-Free Shopping in Oregon in one minute.

hook.text: Oregon has zero sales tax. Shoppers drive from Washington state—which charges 10%—to buy big items across the border.

buildup.text: Oregon funds its government through higher income taxes instead.

discovery.text: Portland malls near the Washington border thrive on cross-border shoppers.

twist.text: Oregon residents pay more income tax than most Americans.

climax.text: Tax competition between states proves people will change behavior—even drive hours—to avoid a few percentage points.

punchline.text: Zero sales tax. Cross-border shoppers prove every percentage point matters.

quiz.question: How does Oregon fund government without sales tax?
